title: Orange Juice vs Soda (Short)
facts: Per 8 fl oz: orange juice ~21 g sugar, ~0.5 g fiber, ~124 mg vit C (~138% DV), ~450 mg potassium; cola ~26 g sugar, 0 nutrients; medium orange ~12 g sugar, ~3 g fiber, ~70 mg vit C. 1 sugar cube ~4 g. Prices approx US.

sentences.text: Your morning orange juice might be closer to soda than you think.
One glass of orange juice. About twenty one grams of sugar.
The same amount of cola. About twenty six grams.
To be fair, juice brings vitamin C and potassium. Soda brings nothing.
But both have almost zero fiber, so the sugar hits your blood fast.
Now the actual orange. Twelve grams of sugar, three grams of fiber, and it keeps you full.
Verdict. Soda: bad. Juice: watch out. The orange: good.
And it costs about the same as a glass of juice.
Follow for more good or bad.
